_note: CÓMO SE PERSONALIZA UNA CUADRA. One record per OSM site whose ground the generic fit gets wrong. This is the mechanism behind Parque Mora y Cañas and the Mercado Municipal, and it was a Python dict until now — which meant only somebody editing the builder could add one.

_options.trace: keep this site's own SOURCE-SUPPORTED cuadra cells and emit their straightened contour, instead of fitting a rectangle. For a place whose identity is the angled contour. NOTE: it keeps the ground OSM already says is the site's — it cannot invent a shape the data does not have.
_options.cuadra: the mapped outline IS a manzana, calle to calle. Implies `trace`, and skips the manzana seat because the site is inside its block by construction.
_options.rect: a sub-rectangle of the fitted rect, in FRACTIONS (u east, v south) as [u0, u1, v0, v1] — for when OSM maps the whole block but the building occupies one corner of it.
_options.kiosco: the parcel carries a kiosco/templete at its centre.

_schema: keys are parcel ids (`osm_<use>_<wayid>`); values are the options above plus an optional `note`.

osm_park_232390078.note: Mora y Cañas spans an ANGLED cuadra. The generic safety fallback kept it off the roadway by inscribing a rectangle, but that cut away the west corner and flattened the diagonal north edge. Keep its source-supported cuadra cells and emit their straightened contour instead.

osm_park_270515697.note: El Parque del Muellero (OSM 'Parque 164') is a 1100 px DIAGONAL RIBBON of waterfront between the Paseo and the muelle, 40-70 px wide — a shape no rectangle in the manzana frame can hold. The percentile fit landed on the roadway, the inscribed fallback found nothing that was still a plot, and the park simply did not exist in the world. Same remedy as Mora y Cañas. Y `shore`: su suelo es MALECÓN y ARENA, no tierra, así que la prueba de LAND/ACERA lo dejaba en 252x96 px de una huella de 1336x463 — el 4 %, con el rótulo flotando fuera de lo que quedaba.

osm_market_1077016901.note: El Mercado Municipal OCCUPIES ITS MANZANA — the mapped outline runs Calle 0B to Calle 2A, Avenida 5 to Avenida 3 Filiberto Sinfontes (its own addr:street). It is a cuadra, like an estadio, not a lot inside one: clipping it to the LAND our carriageways left kept a 266-cell frontage fringe of the 1 300-cell hall. `cuadra` implies `trace`.

osm_school_263127078.note: La Escuela Delia Urbina de Guevara is mapped in OSM as the whole tall manzana it stands on; the school itself is a WIDE building on the block's south-west corner — 'the west 84%, the south 38%'.

osm_campus_232386868.note: La Escuela de Biología Marina (UNA) sits on the WEST side of its calle; the OSM area spans the block and put it along the north edge instead.

osm_park_964080190.note: LA CANCHA MULTIUSOS del Paseo, frente a la Clínica San Rafael. En OSM es `way/964080190`, con el nombre mal escrito («Cqancha de Futbol Playa Puntarenas»), etiquetada `leisure=park` y SIN `sport` — así que el mundo la dibujaba como un parque y, al estar sobre el malecón, la prueba de LAND/ACERA la dejaba en 73x17 px. Es una cancha de baloncesto multiuso: `plaza` le da el pintor de campo abierto y `sport` las marcas. `aceras: false` porque una cancha sobre la arena no tiene acera de la que apartarse: la erosión le comía la mitad de una huella que ya es de 91x31 px.
